ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High macro-level contrast with approximately 70% high-intensity pixels (white) and 30% low-intensity pixels (black) across the visible ventral fluke surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous high-intensity white regions occupy the central-medial portions of both lobes. trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, low-amplitude serrations along the trailing edge of both lobes, with more pronounced pixel-amplitude variations on the left lobe's medial section.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Distinct convex curvature transitioning to a slight concavity near the tips along the trailing edge boundary.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Distinct, localized clusters of high-contrast white pixels located at the distal tips of both the left and right fluke lobes, consistent with barnacle colonization.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Calcified clusters on distal tips of both lobes; partial occlusion of the lower right fluke and peduncle by water spray.
